definition: The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World is a book by Pedro Domingos released in 2015.
details: Domingos wrote the book in order to generate interest from people outside the field.

explainer.lead: Pedro Domingos's 2015 book about the quest for a single ultimate learning machine. It matters because Domingos wrote it to generate interest from people outside the field.

tiers.eli5: Five different teams are each trying to build the one perfect learning machine, and this book explains what each team believes.
tiers.practitioner: Useful for orienting newcomers to the main schools of machine learning; the pitfall is mistaking the title's single algorithm for an existing artefact rather than an open quest.
tiers.paperLevel: The book presents the search for one general learning algorithm as a unifying research goal; it is expository, with no formal definition or proof of such an algorithm's existence.

explainer.example: A reader outside machine learning picks up the book to understand what the different learning approaches are competing over.
